name: R R Kabel Ltd
title: R R Kabel Ltd - 543981 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue +33.7% to INR2,964 cr with volume only ~10% and price-led growth; inventory days rose ~8 and April demand called "normal" despite Middle East disruption and capex of INR1,200 cr FY26-28 still rising.

utilisation.quote: since in cable already we are at optimum utilization of more than 90%

capex.quote: Our INR1,200 crores capex program for FY26 to FY28 is progressing as planned.

triggers.label: Cable utilisation above 90%
triggers.quote: in cable already we are at optimum utilization of more than 90%

triggers.label: Price rise in April; double-digit YTD
triggers.quote: Till now, we have seen more than double-digit price rise already.

triggers.label: Inventory days up ~8 days
triggers.quote: Only eight-days impact in my inventory days.

triggers.label: New cable entrants; mgmt sees no oversupply
triggers.quote: I don't find there will be excess capacity looking to the overall demand in cable side

guidance.quote: whatever we have projected in our slides in the range of 16% to 18%
we are quite positive to achieve our target of 10.5% EBIT margins in wire and cable segment by FY28
now we have, now we are targeting to achieve breakeven in FY27
we are targeting value growth of around 20%-25% in FMEG business
still, like, we are guiding for 9.5% for FY2027

prior_guidance_check.quote: what we have planned to achieve breakeven in March 2026 could not be achieved

prior_guidance_check.metric: Wire & cable margin expansion 300 bps by FY28
prior_guidance_check.quote: We have achieved the almost 130 basis points improvement in margin.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Project RRise 18% CAGR Wires & Cables and 25% CAGR FMEG
prior_guidance_check.quote: we remain on track towards these targets through focused execution

red_flags.label: Inventory up sharply; L/C payables stretch
red_flags.quote: we used these trade facilities more effectively in this quarter

red_flags.label: Q4 inventory gain, unquantified
red_flags.quote: so in this quarter, yes, we had some positive impact in my profitability

red_flags.label: Q4 volume ~10% vs revenue +34%
red_flags.quote: So in this year, quarter, our volumes were like around 10% in volume terms.

evasions.quote: No, not specifically, it is not because since it is continuous process. Not able to quantify.
it becomes very difficult to calculate because revenue depends on so many things.
